text:
Marta (PM): quick triage — we need to pick final scope for the reserved-pools prioritization wedge for the dedicated roadmap. customer asks piling up.
Anjali (Eng): can you list the customer asks? i sketched options yesterday.
Marta (PM): high level: 1) contract-backed burst windows (timeboxed surges), 2) controlled spillover between pools (soft vs hard), 3) autoscale hysteresis tuning + prewarm credits, and 4) clearer billing export for burst usage.
Kevin (Product Ops): from Sales: customers want predictable SLAs during scheduled events and an opt-in spillover that doesn't cost them noise. they also asked for an admin toggle to cap cross-tenant spillover.
Sylvie (ML Eng): ops constraint: large-batch inference patterns mean we need sequence-length aware batching when we allow spillover, otherwise latency SLOs will break.
Dan (SRE): +1. also: if we allow cross-pool spillover, we need a circuit-breaker to stop noisy tenants from starving others. suggest token-bucket + short grace window.
Anjali (Eng): proposal for MVP scope: A) implement same-tier spillover only (no cross-region), B) add prewarm credit ledger (customer-visible), C) autoscale policy with hysteresis and a hard cap per-tenant. keep predictive autoscale as beta.
Marta (PM): that sounds reasonable. what about launch criteria? ops and billing team need exportable fields.
Kevin (Product Ops): must-haves for GA: 1) billing export with burst_breakdown column, 2) dashboard showing reserved vs burst usage per tenant, 3) SLA doc wording for contracted windows.
Dan (SRE): SLO testcases: synthetic flood tests + real-traffic replay. we need a rollback button in console to instantly stop spillover.
Sylvie (ML Eng): config suggestion (prototype):
```
autoscale_policy:
  mode: "burst-hinge"
  headroom_pct: 12
  hysteresis_sec: 45
  spillover: "same-tier-only"
  prewarm_credits: true
  circuit_breaker: {requests_per_min: 10000, cooldown_sec: 300}
```
Anjali (Eng): implementation notes: circuit_breaker will be enforced at admission layer; prewarm credits will deduct from customer's reserved ledger before using burst. need migrations for ledger table.
Marta (PM): risks?
Dan (SRE): risk of oscillation if hysteresis too small; risk of billing confusion if prewarm credit consumption isn't clearly surfaced.
Kevin (Product Ops): commercial risk: we need legal language for contracted windows that clarifies best-effort latency targets vs guaranteed throughput.
Sylvie (ML Eng): performance risk: interactions between KV-cache warming and prewarm path could add 100-200ms for first tokens in some models. include that in release notes.
Marta (PM): decisions: MVP scope = Anjali's proposal. Launch criteria = Kevin's must-haves + Dan's testcases. Risk mitigations = add "rollback spillover" button + clear billing UI copy.
Anjali (Eng): plan for next sprint: 1) ledger + billing export work, 2) admission-level circuit-breaker, 3) simple prewarm credit flow, 4) console toggle for spillover + rollback. estimate 3 sprints.
Kevin (Product Ops): customer communication: draft FAQ (what burst consumes, how credits apply, how to opt out) — i'll start.
Marta (PM): @ops-bot can you open a follow-up RFC ticket with the config proto and acceptance tests?
ops-bot: created ticket #DCR-4871: "reserved-pools: spillover MVP + prewarm ledger" — linked to sprint board.
Marta (PM): thanks team. we'll reconvene after sprint planning to firm dates. :thumbsup:
